messages:
anya: Observed a slow regional probe creep when budget penalties apply. Deprioritized tenants still trigger cross-region probes and slowly consume spare capacity. Need a compact policy fix we can ship fast.

sam: Summary: budget_penalty currently multiplies route_score and indirectly keeps probe gates open. Probes are agnostic to deprioritization intent.

lee: Quick mitigation options: 1) split admission_score vs probe_score, 2) add short-lived probe lease/token per tenant-region, 3) enforce lightweight local quotas. I prefer 1+3 for fast rollout.

ravi: Agreed. Proposal: probe_score = normalize(admission_score) capped to 1.2; probe_hint returned with allowed (bool), remaining_tokens (int), backoff_secs (int). Probe-manager enforces tokens locally; tokens refill at per-tenant rate.

anya: DSL micro-example: 
match tenant == "acme" {
  admission_mult = 1 + budget_penalty
  probe_score = min(1.2, log1p(admission_mult))
  probe_quota_per_min = 12
}
This keeps probes conservative while allowing occasional safety checks.

sam: Implementation notes: compute probe_score deterministically, precompute small LUT for log1p to avoid heavy per-request math. Keep token state in route-manager memory; checkpoint to metadata-store for HA but avoid sync on hot path.

lee: Telemetry: probes_allowed, probes_suppressed, probe_quota_remaining, probe_backoff_count. Alert if probes_suppressed for any tenant with p95_traffic above threshold for >5m. Also weekly recovery sweep that ignores quotas to detect silent regressions.

ravi: Rollback/runbook: runtime toggle to disable quota enforcement -> revert policy config -> run immediate full-health sweep. Canary rollout: 1% -> 5% -> 20%, region-limited, exclude enterprise tier initially.

ops-bot: deploybot: Reminder: schema change for probe_hint requires policy-manager config_version bump and docs update. Canary window recommended 2026-05-20 01:00-05:00 UTC.

anya: Decision: lean +1 for admission/probe split + per-tenant quota + deterministic probe_score + telemetry + quick rollback toggle. I'll draft RFC follow-up and ping reviewers.

sam: I will add tests in probe-manager sim and a staging canary plan.

lee: I'll own the metrics and alert rules.

ravi: I'll implement the probe_hint wire shape and local token checkpointing.

anya: Thanks all, PR in ~3h.
